# From Delegation to Capability {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #00C9A7)"}

Build it once. Run it forever.

## Remember the RICE Prompt? {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="recall" style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1.2em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #00C9A7;"}
In Session 3 you wrote a great delegation — but you typed it out **by hand**.
:::

. . .

::: {style="background: #1C355E; color: #ffffff; padding: 1.2em; border-radius: 12px; text-align: center; font-size: 1.15em; margin-top: 1em;"}
A **Skill** turns that one-time delegation into a **permanent capability** you
**invoke on command** — by name or a trigger phrase, never re-typed.
:::

. . .

::: {style="text-align: center; color: #666; font-size: 0.9em;"}
*The agent-era successor to a "Gem" (Gemini) / "GPT" (ChatGPT) / saved prompt.*
:::

# Anatomy of a Skill {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #9B8EC0)"}

In plain language

## A Saved Recipe Card {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="anatomy" style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1.2em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #9B8EC0;"}
A **recipe card filed in the office.** You say "make the quarterly summary" and the agent
pulls the card and follows it — you don't re-explain the steps.
:::

. . .

A Skill is just three things:

::: {.incremental}
- **A name** — what you call it
- **When to use it (the trigger)** — the phrase that makes the agent *reach for the card* (e.g. "turn this into a deck")
- **The steps** — the recipe, in plain language
:::

. . .

::: {.callout-note}
## No code
You **describe the steps**. That's a "script" — Session 2's recipe card, saved.
:::

# Skill or Standing Instruction? {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #00C9A7)"}

The test: *always-on* vs *invoked on demand*

## Two Homes for a Rule {auto-animate=true}

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1.2em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #9B8EC0;"}
**Standing Instruction** — *Session 6*

A tone, format, or rule you want applied to **every** request.
**Pinned to the Project wall** (`CLAUDE.md`) — always on, you never ask for it.
:::
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1.2em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #00C9A7;"}
**Skill** — *Session 7*

A procedure you **invoke** for a specific job — often producing an **artifact**.
You call it by name / trigger when you need it.
:::
:::
::::

. . .

::: {style="background: #1C355E; color: #ffffff; padding: 1em; border-radius: 12px; text-align: center; margin-top: 1em;"}
"Always write memos in our house voice" → **standing instruction.**
"Turn *these* notes into a memo, now" → **Skill you invoke.**
:::

::: {style="text-align: center; color: #666; font-size: 0.85em; margin-top: 0.4em;"}
*Same capability — the test is whether it's always-on or invoked on demand.*
:::

# Instructor Demo {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #FF7A5C, #1C355E)"}

"Build-a-Deck"

## What We're Building {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="deck" style="background: #1C355E; color: #ffffff; padding: 1.5em; border-radius: 12px; text-align: center; font-size: 1.2em;"}
**"Build-a-Deck"**
:::

. . .

Paste **raw, messy notes** → get an **on-brand slide deck** you can export to **`.pptx`**.
Save it once as a Skill — then **invoke** it on any future update.

## Step 1: The Recipe {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="recipe" style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1em; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 0.8em;"}
**Name:** Build-a-Deck

**When to use (the trigger):** When I say *"turn these notes / this update into a deck."*

**Steps:**

1. **Outline first** — draft the storyline before any slide
2. **One idea per slide** — a clear title + a few supporting points
3. **Apply our house style** — colors, fonts, logo
4. **Export** — hand back a downloadable **`.pptx`**
:::

## Step 2: Invoke It {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="recipe" style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 0.6em; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 0.7em; border-left: 4px solid #00C9A7;"}
Skill saved — now **type the trigger** on a fresh input to prove it pulls the recipe:
:::

::: {style="background: #1C355E; color: #ffffff; padding: 0.8em; border-radius: 12px; font-style: italic; font-size: 0.8em; text-align: center;"}
"Turn this into a **5-slide deck**: Q3 hit target, two regions lagging, new hire starts Monday, asking the board for budget."
:::

## The Output {auto-animate=true}

::: {style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1em; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 0.8em;"}
A titled, on-brand deck — exportable to **`.pptx`**:

1. **Q3 Results** — target met, momentum strong
2. **Where We're Lagging** — two regions below plan
3. **The Plan** — new hire starts Monday
4. **The Ask** — budget for next quarter
5. **Next Steps** — owners + dates
:::

::: {style="text-align: center; color: #00C9A7; font-weight: bold; margin-top: 0.5em; font-size: 0.9em;"}
↓ Download as .pptx
:::

## What Just Happened {auto-animate=true}

::: {.incremental}
- We typed **one trigger phrase** — no Role, no format, no re-explaining the steps
- The Skill pulled the saved recipe and built the deck
- A downloadable **artifact** in seconds
:::

. . .

::: {.callout-note}
## Coming in Session 10
Making that deck genuinely **board-ready** — the narrative (Amazon Method) and the
Design Engine — is Session 10. Here the point is simply: a Skill can **produce an
artifact on command**.
:::

# Your Workflow Library {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #9B8EC0)"}

One recipe at a time

## Skills Managers Actually Use {auto-animate=true}

Each one is a **trigger → recipe** the agent pulls on command:

::: {style="font-size: 0.85em;"}
| You say… | The Skill it pulls |
|---|---|
| "make a deck" | **Build-a-Deck** → on-brand `.pptx` |
| "/summarize these notes" | **Briefer** → BLUF decision memo |
| "meeting → actions" | **Minutes → Actions** → owners + deadlines |
| "draft the weekly report" | **Weekly Status** → leadership update *(automate in Session 9)* |
| "summarize this contract" | **Document Summary** → key changes + risks |
:::

. . .

::: {style="text-align: center; color: #00C9A7; font-weight: bold; margin-top: 0.6em;"}
Your library grows **one recipe at a time** — build the ones you repeat.
:::

## Key Takeaways {.sdaia-dark background-color="#1C355E"}

::: {.incremental}
1. **Skill = a saved recipe card you invoke by a trigger** (vs an always-on Standing Instruction — Session 6)
2. **Anatomy** — a name, a **trigger** (when-to-use), the steps (plain language, no code)
3. **Skills produce artifacts** — a deck/`.pptx`, a memo, a report — on command
4. **Write once, invoke forever** — prove it generalizes by running the trigger on a new input
5. **Don't over-engineer** — Skills for recurring tasks, chat for true one-offs
:::
